$comment: MCP tool contract for the shared `review` server (AB#645219). Schema is the TARGET contract. Current handler (Invoke-ReviewTool.ps1) is a behavior-preserving per-phase pass-through: it sets REVIEW_PHASE=generate and delegates to Invoke-CopilotPRReview.ps1 (inputs via env, output via REVIEW_OUTPUT_DIR). A real stdio MCP server (Start-ReviewMcpServer.ps1) advertises this tool over JSON-RPC using this file as the source of truth. This is an ADDITIVE, opt-in capability - review.yml still calls the script directly, so existing pipelines are untouched; consumers migrate one at a time. This JSON I/O is honored once the generate logic physically moves into the tool. `review` is consumed identically by PROD and BC-Bench.
name: review
description: Filter BCQuality @ ref, run the model with the one shared review prompt/skills wiring, parse findings, then apply content-level dedup + cap. Returns findings plus the resolved provenance (BCQuality SHA, engine/plugin version, model, min severity). Never posts.

repo_ref.description: owner/repo@ref of the review target. Mutually exclusive with local_path.

local_path.description: Filesystem path to a checked-out review target (BC-Bench / local). Mutually exclusive with repo_ref.

base_ref.description: Base ref of the change. The three-dot merge-base is computed internally. Mutually exclusive with diff.

diff.description: Pre-computed unified diff to review. Mutually exclusive with base_ref.

bcquality_ref.description: Which BCQuality to use: branch / SHA / local worktree path / customer custom layer. Omit to use the engine default pinned version (Z). PROD never overrides this.

model.description: Copilot model the review runs with. BC-Bench varies this as its benchmark independent variable.

resolved.description: Per-run provenance so every score is attributable and reproducible.

bcquality_sha.description: The BCQuality commit actually resolved to - the ground truth even when bcquality_ref was overridden.
